clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul teaches a silent sign to new rogues. The Shattered Hand uses it to recognize its agents safely in the field.

In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, the Shattered Hand works in secrecy as Thrall's Horde intelligence and assassination arm. Its agents cannot use banners or military signs on dangerous, secret assignments. Shenthul teaches newly inducted rogues the Shattered Salute, a silent gesture that lets allies recognize one another.

For Shenthul's rogues, learning the salute is vital tradecraft, not ceremony. Agents sent into danger or to infiltrate rival factions need to verify contacts without alerting bystanders or targets. Before entrusting an agent with covert fieldwork, Shenthul expects them to recognize and mirror the gesture without hesitation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a rogue of the Shattered Hand, it is imperative that you learn the Shattered Salute. It is the only way to truly identify another member of the Hand.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You are now ready to proceed.
